_om:
Gjør stillbildet på /bransjer/klinikker om til bevegelse. Bygges med den DELTE rørledningen: `node scripts/scene.mjs lev2-klinikk --fil assets/prompter/levende2.json --kun-bilder` først, se på rammene, så uten flagget.

Startbildet bruker samme redigering som stillbildet på siden (assets/prompter/bransjer.json, «bransje-klinikk»), så komposisjonen er den kunden allerede har sett. Sluttbildet redigeres FRA startbildet – det er den rettingen som gjør at underdelingen arves i stedet for å gjettes på nytt.
_bevar: This is a precision product shot. Keep absolutely everything identical: camera position, focal length, perspective, framing and crop, the exact position, angle and length of the horizontal bar, the number and width of the recesses along its top face, the rib widths and 45-degree chamfers, lighting direction and intensity, the thin rim light from behind right, reflections, the soft short contact shadow, the near-black #0b0d10 seamless studio background, and the matte bead-blasted anodised aluminium material. The bar is rigid: it does not move, rotate, stretch, shorten, or change its subdivision. Do not re-frame, do not zoom, do not crop closer or wider. All surfaces stay plain and unmarked: no text, letters, numbers, logos, icons or watermarks anywhere. No people, no hands, no faces.
_bevegelse: Locked-off static camera on a tripod. The camera does not move, zoom, pan, dolly or reframe at any point. Silent product shot. Start exactly on the first supplied frame and end exactly on the last supplied frame. Hold completely still for the first half second and the last half second; in between, one single continuous movement at constant speed. Every object is rigid and keeps its exact shape, size, thickness, width and material in every frame, and never bends, melts, morphs, stretches, rotates or changes count. The horizontal bar, its length and its subdivision are identical in every single frame. Lighting, reflections and the background stay constant throughout. Avoid: camera movement, camera shake, zoom, pan, dolly, cut, scene change, lens change, reframing, morphing, melting, warping, objects changing size or count, extra objects appearing, objects disappearing, text, letters, logos, watermark, flicker, particles, lens flare, motion blur, depth-of-field change.

scener._hvorfor: Siden handler om timer som bestilles mens klinikken er stengt. Stillbildet viser målestokken med de aller fleste feltene tomme – det ER problemet. Bevegelsen er svaret: feltene fylles ett for ett, uten at noen i resepsjonen gjør noe. Skinnen står helt stille; det eneste som skjer er at tomrommet blir til timer.
scener._merk: Forrige forsøk (bransje-fylling) ble vraket fordi rammene ikke var kjedet: startbildet hadde ni brede felt, sluttbildet rundt seksten smale, og de to var dessuten 1280x720 og 2048x1152. Underdelingen av skinnen endret seg, og et klipp mellom to slike rammer er en morf, ikke en bevegelse. Her arves underdelingen fordi sluttbildet redigeres fra startbildet. Første forsøk på sluttbildet fylte INGENTING – samme tre felt lyste, bare med en limegrønn strek lagt til. Modellen overså «fill the empty recesses». Ordlyden er derfor skjerpet til å telle: hvert eneste felt, null tomme, ingen mørke åpninger.
scener.bevar: Keep exactly identical: camera position, focal length, perspective, framing and crop, the exact position, angle and length of the aluminium bar, the number and width of every recess along its top face, the rib widths and chamfers, lighting direction and intensity, the rim light, reflections, the contact shadow, the near-black #0b0d10 background and the matte bead-blasted anodised aluminium material. The bar itself never moves and its subdivision never changes. Nothing is added beside or above the bar. All surfaces stay plain and blank: no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere.
scener.start: Replace the arrangement entirely: there is no longer a stack of plates. Instead ONE single long horizontal bar of matte bead-blasted anodised aluminium lies flat across the frame, like a precision measuring rail. Its top face is divided along its whole length into TWELVE identical rectangular recesses of exactly equal width, separated by thin raised ribs with fine 45-degree chamfers, so the bar reads as a strictly regular graduated scale. Count them carefully: exactly TWELVE equal recesses. THREE of the recesses hold a flush insert of frosted borosilicate glass with soft internal diffusion; the remaining NINE recesses are empty and show the dark machined floor of the recess. The three filled recesses are scattered, not adjacent. Nothing hovers above the bar; the air above it is plain empty near-black background. No lime green line anywhere in the image. The bar occupies the right 60 percent of the frame; the left third stays calm empty near-black negative space.
scener.slutt: Change ONE thing only: every recess is now filled. EVERY SINGLE rectangular recess along the top face of the bar — all of them, from the far left end to the far right end, without exception — now holds a flush insert of frosted borosilicate glass with soft internal diffusion, lit from within exactly like the three inserts that were already glowing in the supplied image. ZERO recesses are empty. NO recess shows a dark machined floor. There are NO dark openings anywhere along the bar. Every opening that was a dark square is now a bright frosted glass panel. The bar itself is completely unchanged: identical position, identical angle, identical length, identical number of recesses, identical rib widths, identical chamfers, identical material, identical framing and camera. Nothing hovers above the bar and nothing is added beside it; the background stays plain near-black exactly as before. One single hair-thin lime green #c8f24a edge line runs along the top chamfer of one rib near the middle of the bar, and nowhere else.
scener.bevegelse: The frosted glass inserts appear and settle into place inside their recesses one after another along the length of the bar, in a steady left-to-right sequence at constant speed, each one becoming a flush filled panel in the recess it belongs to. The aluminium bar itself stays absolutely still and unchanged throughout: it does not move, shift, rotate, lengthen, or alter the number or width of its recesses in any frame. Nothing descends from above, nothing hovers, and no object enters the frame from outside. Near the end, a single hair-thin lime green edge line lights up softly along one rib near the middle of the bar.
scener.alt: En lang aluminiumsskinne delt i like store felt langs hele lengden. Feltene fylles med frostet glass ett for ett mens skinnen selv står helt stille.
scener.tekst: Timene fylles mens klinikken er stengt. Skinnen er den samme – det eneste som endrer seg, er hvor mange felt som er solgt.
